ModMetaData.name: Filter by Example
ModMetaData.author: CoolNether123
ModMetaData.description:
Select one or more real items, choose Allow or Disallow by example, then click a stockpile, shelf, or storage building.
Filter by Example changes only those exact item definitions in the target's real storage filter. It supports linked shelves and modded item definitions without category-wide, quality, hit-point, stuff, ingredient, or priority changes.
Allow by example and Disallow by example each have a configurable entry in RimWorld's normal Controls menu.
